name: Tactical Insight
text:
**Tactical Insight**

**School** divination; **Level** bard 6, inquisitor 6, skald 6
**Casting Time** 1 standard action
**Components** V, S
**Range** 1 hex
**Target** one army
**Duration** 1 battle
**Saving Throw** none; **Spell Resistance** no

Choose a single army tactic. You grant mastery of this tactic to the
 target army for the spell’s duration. This tactic may bring an army’s
 total known tactics to a number greater than normally allowed.
